podcast.title: Shoegaze Band Example
podcast.body: Adorable was mentioned as an example of a Shoegaze band, which typically featured vocals buried deep in the mix, contributing to its immersive and dreamy sonic aesthetic. "There were bands like Slow Dive, Chapter House, Curve, Lush, My Bloody Valentine, Adorable, The Catherine Wheel."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Shoegaze Band Example
xref.body: Slowdive was mentioned as an example of a Shoegaze band, a loud, fuzzy, buzzy form of guitar rock that emerged from the Thames River Valley in the very late 80s and early 90s. "There were bands like Slow Dive, Chapter House, Curve, Lush, My Bloody Valentine, Adorable, The Catherine Wheel."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Shoegaze Band Example
xref.body: Chapter House was mentioned as an example of a Shoegaze band, a genre characterized by lots of distortion, feedback, buried vocals, and a disarming amount of melody, often described as immersive, semi-psychedelic, and dreamy. "There were bands like Slow Dive, Chapter House, Curve, Lush, My Bloody Valentine, Adorable, The Catherine Wheel."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Shoegaze Band Example
xref.body: Curve was mentioned as an example of a Shoegaze band, a style known for its performers' habit of avoiding audience contact by staring at the floor, which gave the genre its name. "There were bands like Slow Dive, Chapter House, Curve, Lush, My Bloody Valentine, Adorable, The Catherine Wheel."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Shoegaze Band Example
xref.body: My Bloody Valentine was mentioned as an example of a Shoegaze band, originating from the Thames River Valley outside of London, characterized by its loud, fuzzy, and buzzy guitar rock sound. "There were bands like Slow Dive, Chapter House, Curve, Lush, My Bloody Valentine, Adorable, The Catherine Wheel."

xref.title: Shoegaze Band Example
xref.body: The Catherine Wheel was mentioned as an example of a Shoegaze band, a genre that, if not for Grunge's emergence, might have survived more prominently but instead retreated into the background. "There were bands like Slow Dive, Chapter House, Curve, Lush, My Bloody Valentine, Adorable, The Catherine Wheel."

xref.title: Young Drum Prodigy
xref.body: Nandi Bushell is an adorable young drum prodigy, not yet a teenager, who displays exceptional drumming talent. She is considered capable of filling in for Danny Carey of Tool due to her skill. Dave Grohl is a "huge, huge fan" of hers, recognizing her remarkable ability at such a young age. "She's not even a teenager yet, but if Toul ever needed someone to fill in for Danny Kerry, this kid could do it. She is that good. Dave Grohl is a huge, huge fan of Nandy Bushel."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
